_readme: The steps the Operator Agent may carry out itself (DRE-8922, epic DRE-8738): the four kinds, each kind's one credential, and each op's fields, the argv it becomes and whether it writes. Read only through scripts/operator_do_ops.py, whose load refuses a kind outside operator_step_kind.MACHINE_KINDS, the deploy kind (a deploy needs production access and is the studio's, never do), a credential other than GH_TOKEN or LINEAR_API_KEY, and a command naming a field its op does not declare. A command is an argv list: each `{field}` in an element is replaced by the op's value, `{field|base64}` by its base64, `{field*}` by its list spread as arguments, and a bool reads `true` or `false`. A field's type says how check reads it: `repo` is an owner/name value of config/repo-map.json that opens `org`, and a plan names at most one; `variable` and `project` must be quoted word for word in the card's title or description outside fenced code; `branch` must be quoted or be `agent/<the plan's card>-<slug>`, and is never one of `never_branches`; `path` under .github/workflows/ must be quoted; `sha` is a 40-hex commit sha (a branch-create starts at a commit, and GitHub's refs API takes no branch name); `status` is one of the op's `choices`; `script` is a key of `scripts`, and `args` must take that script's one form. file-put adds a file the branch does not yet hold: replacing one needs the old blob's sha, which no op reads. pr-open's base is main, the default branch of every dreadnought-foundry repository in the map (read 2026-11-03). No op runs or lists a workflow, sets a secret, or reaches an organization or an environment, and an Initiative is not an op: a step that needs any of them is refused by check and left for a person. `never` are the agent's own switches, refused wherever an op names them. max_ops caps one plan; max_do_per_pass is applied by the workflow, since the executor runs one card per call (DRE-8928, DRE-8924), and max_close_per_pass and pr_wait_days are read by the close (DRE-8925). Adding an op is a reviewed pull request; tests/test_operator_do_ops.py renders every one.

variable.mint: A bureau App installation token for the plan's one repository, minted with no permission-* subset: the pinned actions/create-github-app-token declares no input for repository variables and GitHub refuses the undeclared permission-variables (DRE-7230), so the token carries every permission the installation grants on that repository (DRE-8928). The grant it needs is actions_variables: write, which the probe reads for every fleet repository (DRE-8924).

bot-pr.mint: A token for the plan's one repository minted with contents: write and pull_requests: write only (DRE-8928) — the two permissions the probe reads besides actions_variables. No op needs actions: read or write.

linear-admin.mint: The fleet's Linear key, a member key and not an admin. A workspace member may change a team project's status; Linear refusing the projectUpdate all the same is a command that exits non-zero, and nothing is changed.

script.mint: A read-only token for the plan's one repository.
